name: Kurosawa Sekien
source: A Nurarihyon who has lived in the Yamagata family for generations disguised as a human. He once founded a demon gang "One Hundred Demons Night Parade" that is as powerful as the NKK, but now has given the responsibility of the leader to his son-in-law Kiba.
translation: A Nurarihyon who has lived in the Yamagata family for generations disguised as a human. He once founded a demon gang "One Hundred Demons Night Parade" that is as powerful as the NKK, but now has given the responsibility of the leader to his son-in-law Kiba.
